output_list.criticism: The balanceOf function does not check for integer overflow when calculating the balance of an address. This can lead to incorrect balance calculations if the total supply of tokens is very large.
The transfer function does not check for integer overflow when updating the balances of the sender and receiver. This can lead to incorrect balance calculations if the transfer amount is very large.

The transferFrom function does not check for integer overflow when updating the balances of the sender, receiver, and spender. This can lead to incorrect balance calculations if the transfer amount is very large.

The approve function does not check for integer overflow when updating the allowed amount of tokens for a spender. This can lead to incorrect allowance calculations if the approve amount is very large.
The constructor of the EighteenToken contract has a typo in the name of the contract. It should be EighteenToken instead of EighteenToken.
